title: The Door That Locked
subtitle: 卫浴与浴室 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 卫浴与浴室（生活与学习·居家空间）
meta: 主题语境：卫浴与浴室（生活与学习·居家空间）　|　核心词汇：bathroom　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bathroom 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my grandmother was shown ① a bathroom with a lock on the inside and said it was the first door in the house that belonged to her. The ② bathroom, meaning the room and not the tap, was nine feet square and was shared by five people for eleven years; a bathroom, she said, is the only room where everybody is equal and nobody agrees.

Every ③ bathroom in that street had the same tile, and the ④ bathroom at the top of the stairs, meaning the one with the window that stuck and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever fought over. A bathroom, my mother said, is nine parts schedule and one part somebody willing to be quick; my grandmother said the schedule is the part that breaks.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bathroom was the whole of the morning, meaning the queue and not the room. The ⑥ bathroom, meaning the wait and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that is decided by who works earliest; a bathroom, he said, is either a room with a lock or the only word that means both a place and a queue. She said the queue came first.

By 1968 the ⑦ bathroom had become a photograph in a magazine, and the magazine had become an argument about whether a house needed two. The ⑧ bathroom of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in April, was nine feet and eleven years of knocking; a bathroom, she said, is either the room at the top of the stairs or the reason you learned to knock. He said the knocking was the part that mattered.

The ⑨ bathroom I remember is the one with the window that stuck, which was still sticking in 1971 and was never fixed. A ⑩ bathroom, my mother said in 1973, is the only room that improves by being shared; every bathroom, she said, is a queue that has agreed to look like a room. She said the queue was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 浴室（指那间屋，与水龙头相对）
C. 固定搭配：be shown a bathroom 被领着看一间浴室
D. n. 浴室（指那条街上每一间）
E. n. 浴室（指楼梯顶上那一间）
F. n. 洗澡间（指早晨排队等的那段时间）
G. n. 排队（抽象：等候这件事）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bathroom with a lock on the inside

the bathroom at the top of the stairs

answers.why: be shown a bathroom 意为“被领着看一间浴室”，1954 年祖母被领着看一间门能从里面锁上的浴室。
bathroom 意为“浴室”，指那间屋而不是水龙头，它九英尺见方，五个人共用了十一年。
bathroom 指那条街上每一间浴室，那条街上每一间都贴着同一种瓷砖。
bathroom 指楼梯顶上那一间（窗子卡住的那一间），是唯一有人真会争起来的。
bathroom 意为“洗澡间”，指早晨排队等的那段时间，父亲说它就是整个早晨。
bathroom 为抽象用法，指等候这件事，是屋里唯一由谁上班最早来决定的东西。
bathroom 意为“浴室”，到 1968 年这个 bathroom 成了杂志上的一张照片。
bathroom 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖母四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英尺和十一年的敲门声。
bathroom 意为“浴室”，我记得的是窗子卡住那一间，1971 年还卡着，从没修过。
bathroom 为抽象总称，母亲说浴室是唯一会因为共用而变好的房间。
